description: Create a 'Buy 2 Get 1 Free' cart price rule for the Clothing category. Go to Marketing > Cart Price Rules. Create a new rule named 'Clothing BOGO'. Settings: Active, Website: Main Website, Customer Groups: All, No Coupon (Auto-apply), Priority 1. Conditions: Apply ONLY to items in the 'Clothing' category. Actions: 'Buy X get Y free', Discount Amount: 1, Discount Qty Step (Buy X): 3 (since Buy 2 + Get 1 = 3 items total). Enable 'Discard Subsequent Rules'. Save the rule. If not logged in, use admin/Admin1234!.
